title: hieracium jurassicum subsp. remotifrons
intro: Hieracium jurassicum subsp. remotifrons, commonly known as the Jurassic Hawkweed, is a perennial herb belonging to the Asteraceae family. This plant is known to have various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of infections. The therapeutic actions of Jurassic Hawkweed include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and immunomodulatory effects, making it a potential remedy for various health conditions. Bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
